_comment: AWS resource types whose destruction loses data (or identities, or DNS control) that cannot be recovered by re-applying. These are expected to carry lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }. This list stays hand-curated on purpose: 'destroying this hurts' is a judgment call, not a fact the provider schema exposes. Inclusion criterion: after `terraform destroy` + `terraform apply`, is the resource's *content* gone? Stateless things that simply get recreated (an aws_lb, an aws_ecs_service) deliberately do not belong here — flagging them would train people to ignore the rule. Every entry is validated against the provider schema at pack-generation time, so a renamed or removed type is caught rather than silently ignored.
